# Background
This script produces a cross table of maternal features and birth outcomes for the mother-child dyads for which stool samples were sequenced. Features of interest are selected, categorized, mutated as appropriate, recombined, and then put in a cross table of "analyzed" vs "excluded" (not included in manuscript) or "analyzed" vs "whole". 


## Packages

```{r Packages}

#if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
#  install.packages("BiocManager")
#BiocManager::install()

#BiocManager::install("phyloseq")
library(phyloseq)

#install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)

#install.packages("here")
library(here)

#install.packages("crosstable")
library(crosstable)
```

## Load data
```{r Loading data}

#loading data
load(here("results/filtered_dada_2_output_environment.RData"))

```


## Data organization
### Extracting information into data frames

```{r Sample data to data frame}

#labeling kept samples
sample_data <- ps_analysis_2@sam_data %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Sample.ID") %>% 
  mutate(dataset = "analized")

nrow(sample_data) #237


sample_data_2 <- ps_analysis_1@sam_data %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Sample.ID")

nrow(sample_data_2) #368

#labeling excluded samples
sample_data_3 <- full_join(sample_data, sample_data_2) %>% 
  mutate(dataset = case_when(dataset == "analized" ~ "analized",
                            .default = "excluded"))

dataset <- select(sample_data_3, Sample.ID, dataset)

#labeling whole data set
sample_data_4 <- sample_data_2%>% 
  mutate(dataset = "Whole")

sample_data_4 <- full_join(sample_data_4, sample_data)

nrow(sample_data_4) #605

```



### Seperating/combining information into data frames based on categories


```{r Maternal Serology data frame}

Maternal_serology <- select(sample_data_3, Sample.ID, Anemia_Binary, inflammation_AGP_cat, inflammation_CRP_cat, calprotectin_ug.g) %>% 
mutate(inflammation_calprotectin_cat = case_when(calprotectin_ug.g >= 50 ~ "Elevated Calprotectin", calprotectin_ug.g < 50 ~ "Normal Calprotectin")) %>% 
  select(-calprotectin_ug.g)
#50 micrograms/gram as cut off for normal/elevated calprotectin


```

```{r child info}

child <- select(sample_data_3, Sample.ID, Sex) %>% mutate(Sex = factor(Sex))

```


```{r cofactors}
#making sure variables are "factors"
cofactors <- select(sample_data_3, Sample.ID, Maternal_age_cat, Maternal_education_cat, Parity_cat, Wealth_index, BMI_cat, BMI) %>% 
  mutate(Maternal_age_cat = factor(Maternal_age_cat, levels = c("<18", "18-35", ">35"))) %>% 
  mutate(Maternal_education_cat = factor(Maternal_education_cat, levels = c("No Education", "1-5", "6-10", ">10"))) %>% 
  mutate(Parity_cat = factor(Parity_cat, levels = c("0", "1-2", ">2"))) %>% 
  mutate(Wealth_index = factor(Wealth_index, levels = c("Poorest", "Poorer", "middle", "Ricehest", "Richer"))) %>% 
  mutate(BMI_cat = factor(BMI_cat, levels = c("Underweight", "Healthy Weight", "Overweight", "Obese"))) 

```


```{r Enteric Pathogens data frame}

aEPEC <- select(sample_data_3, Sample.ID, aEPEC_cat)


```

```{r birth outcomes data frame}
#including large for gestational age in the "normal" category
#defining SVN to exclude those with miscarriges etc.
Birth_outcomes <- select(sample_data_3, Sample.ID, Born_Alive, Percential_weight.GA, Birth_weight_cat, GA_birth_binary, GA_birth, Birth_weight) %>% 
  mutate(Percential_weight.GA_2 = case_when(Percential_weight.GA == "normal" | Percential_weight.GA == "LGA" ~ "Normal", Percential_weight.GA == "SGA" ~ "SGA")) %>% 
   mutate(SVN = case_when(Percential_weight.GA_2 == "SGA" | Birth_weight_cat == "Low Birth Weight" | GA_birth_binary == "Preterm" ~ "SVN", .default = "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(Single_outcome_SVN = case_when(Born_Alive == "1" & Percential_weight.GA_2 == "Normal" & Birth_weight_cat == "Normal Weight" & GA_birth_binary == "Term" ~ "Healthy", Born_Alive == "1" & SVN == "SVN" ~ "SVN", .default = "Other"))

```


## cross table for those included vs excluded in analysis

```{r create data frame with all variables of interest}
excluded_ct_df <- Birth_outcomes %>% 
  full_join(dataset) %>% 
  full_join(cofactors) %>% 
  full_join(child) %>% 
  full_join(Maternal_serology) %>% 
  full_join(aEPEC) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample.ID")  

nrow(excluded_ct_df)

excluded_ct_df_whole <- select(sample_data_4, Sample.ID, dataset, Anemia_Binary, inflammation_AGP_cat, inflammation_CRP_cat, calprotectin_ug.g, Sex, Maternal_age_cat, Maternal_education_cat, Parity_cat, Wealth_index, BMI_cat, BMI, aEPEC_cat, Born_Alive, Percential_weight.GA, Birth_weight_cat, GA_birth_binary, GA_birth, Birth_weight) %>% 
  mutate(Percential_weight.GA_2 = case_when(Percential_weight.GA == "normal" | Percential_weight.GA == "LGA" ~ "Normal", Percential_weight.GA == "SGA" ~ "SGA")) %>% 
   mutate(SVN = case_when(Percential_weight.GA_2 == "SGA" | Birth_weight_cat == "Low Birth Weight" | GA_birth_binary == "Preterm" ~ "SVN", .default = "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(Single_outcome_SVN = case_when(Born_Alive == "1" & Percential_weight.GA_2 == "Normal" & Birth_weight_cat == "Normal Weight" & GA_birth_binary == "Term" ~ "Healthy", Born_Alive == "1" & SVN == "SVN" ~ "SVN", .default = "Other"))%>% 
  mutate(Maternal_age_cat = factor(Maternal_age_cat, levels = c("<18", "18-35", ">35"))) %>% 
  mutate(Maternal_education_cat = factor(Maternal_education_cat, levels = c("No Education", "1-5", "6-10", ">10"))) %>% 
  mutate(Parity_cat = factor(Parity_cat, levels = c("0", "1-2", ">2"))) %>% 
  mutate(Wealth_index = factor(Wealth_index, levels = c("Poorest", "Poorer", "middle", "Ricehest", "Richer"))) %>% 
  mutate(BMI_cat = factor(BMI_cat, levels = c("Underweight", "Healthy Weight", "Overweight", "Obese")))  %>% 
  mutate(Sex = factor(Sex))%>% 
  mutate(inflammation_calprotectin_cat = case_when(calprotectin_ug.g >= 50 ~ "Elevated Calprotectin", calprotectin_ug.g < 50 ~ "Normal Calprotectin")) %>% 
  select(-c(calprotectin_ug.g, Sample.ID))   

nrow(excluded_ct_df_whole)

```


```{ cross table}
#included vs excluded crosstable
excluded_CT <- crosstable(excluded_ct_df, by = dataset, total="both", test = TRUE)

excluded_CT%>%
  as_flextable()

#significant difference between wealth index and anemia and calprotectin

```


```{r cross table (whole)}

#included vs whole cross table
excluded_CT_whole <- crosstable(excluded_ct_df_whole, by = dataset, total="both", test = TRUE)

excluded_CT_whole%>%
  as_flextable()

```
